title: The Molten River
text: A river of slow fire crosses the valley, orange and black, crawling, steaming where it touches the air. Stepping stones of cooled rock bob on it, rising and sinking. Some of them sink and do not come back up.

options.label: Hop the stones across the fire, and hope they hold.

outcomes.text: Across, with singed boots and blistered feet.
A stone sinks, and fire licks up to the knee.

options.label: The quickest goes first and calls the safe stones for the rest.

outcomes.text: Every stone called right, and everyone across.

options.label: Wait for a frost-breathing wyrm to cool a bridge, and hope it does not notice you.

outcomes.text: It comes, and it cools a bridge, and then it sees you.
